no-cushion.name: No savings
no-cushion.line: I couldn't cover a surprise bill if one came.
no-cushion.why: Brings the wording back to the cushion the ID names, says what having nothing put aside looks like in a day, and makes the name a problem like Broke and Debt.

no-cushion.name: No savings
no-cushion.line: I have nothing put aside if something goes wrong.
no-cushion.why: Keeps the original line almost as it was and only adds when the missing savings would matter; the name becomes a problem like Broke and Debt.

cant-stop-working.name: Can't retire
cant-stop-working.line: I won't have enough to stop working when I'm older.
cant-stop-working.why: Says the worry the ID names, never being able to stop working, in plain words, and makes the name a problem like Broke and Debt instead of an area.

cant-stop-working.name: Can't retire
cant-stop-working.line: I'll have to keep working because I won't have enough to retire.
cant-stop-working.why: Keeps the original line's retirement wording and adds what it means for the person; the name becomes a problem like Broke and Debt.

running-out-of-food.name: Not enough food
running-out-of-food.line: I worry the food won't last until my next paycheck.
running-out-of-food.why: Says plainly what the pain is, matching the problem names Broke and Debt, and ties the line to a moment people know instead of the calendar month.

running-out-of-food.name: Not enough food
running-out-of-food.line: I worry the food won't last the month.
running-out-of-food.why: Keeps the original line, which is already plain, and only changes the area name Food into a problem name like Broke and Debt.

broke.name: Broke
broke.line: I run out of money before my next paycheck.
broke.why: Says what being always short looks like, so it reads less like Debt or No savings and more like the month-to-month squeeze.
